title: arenaria leptoclados subsp. viscidula
intro: Arenaria leptoclados subsp. viscidula, commonly known as Sticky Rock-cress, is a plant species in the carnation family that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Sticky Rock-cress include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional herbal medicine.
